hero.subheadline: Joey Dahan helps you pick the layout, tile and fixtures himself, then his team builds it. Clients call it a designer space without paying for a designer.

image.alt: Bathroom remodeling San Diego: luxury bath with marble slab walls, floating oak vanity and backlit oval mirrors

intro.h2: The owner sits at the table for every design decision
paragraphs: Craft Home Remodeling offers bathroom remodeling in San Diego from a small office in Rancho Bernardo. Founder Joey Dahan works with each client on the design, so you can reach a finished look without signing a separate design contract.

That hands-on approach shows up in the reviews. Clients say Joey listens closely, gives honest advice and keeps the job on schedule. One kitchen client spent close to a year refining details with him. Projects range from guest baths and powder rooms to spa-style primary suites, and the same team also remodels kitchens and complete homes from Scripps Ranch to La Jolla.

services.h2: Bathrooms, kitchens and whole homes in San Diego County

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: Primary suites, guest baths and powder rooms, from walk-in glass showers and freestanding tubs to floating oak vanities and custom tile. Joey helps you choose fixtures and finishes so the room feels designed, not just updated. Recent baths include projects in Scripps Ranch and Sorrento Valley.

image.alt: Bathroom remodel in Sorrento Valley, San Diego with wavy white tile shower and oak vanity

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Kitchen remodels are the work clients mention most in Google reviews. Expect custom cabinetry, stone or quartz counters, smarter storage and layouts that improve the way you cook. Past kitchens include a two-tone navy and white kitchen in La Jolla and a walnut and marble kitchen in Encinitas.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel in La Jolla, CA with white shaker cabinets, navy island, brass pulls and floating wood shelves

items.name: Complete Home Renovations
items.blurb: Whole-house remodels that bring kitchens, baths, living areas and finishes together under one plan, including additions and ADUs. Craft has completed full-home projects in Rancho Santa Fe, Solana Beach, Del Mar and Encinitas, and one client's living room work included a new gas fireplace.

image.alt: Complete home remodel in Rancho Santa Fe, CA with open kitchen, light oak cabinets and quartz waterfall island

about.h2: Meet Joey Dahan, founder and owner
about.text: Joey Dahan started Craft Home Remodeling to raise the level of customer service in remodeling for families in his hometown of San Diego. He sees a home as more than a space, and he stays involved from the first idea to the reveal. Clients describe an owner who knows construction well, understands San Diego building styles and has a good eye for design. His promise to clients is short: he and his team are excited to partner with you in turning your house into a home that reflects you.

process.h2: How a Craft remodel comes together

steps.title: Free consult
steps.text: Share your goals and get creative layout and color ideas tailored to your style, with no cost to talk it through.

steps.title: Construction proposal
steps.text: A transparent scope of work and a budget plan, so you know what is included before any work is scheduled.

steps.title: Planning and design
steps.text: Joey helps you pick tile, fixtures, cabinetry and finishes, so the design is complete before demolition starts.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Craft's crew and trusted craftsmen build the plan while Joey stays in touch and keeps the project on schedule.

steps.title: Reveal and enjoy
steps.text: You walk through the finished room with the team. Craft backs the work with a complete satisfaction guarantee.

service_area.h2: From Rancho Bernardo to the coast
service_area.text: Craft works out of the Montadura business park on W Bernardo Ct in Rancho Bernardo and remodels homes across San Diego County. Inland jobs include Scripps Ranch, 4S Ranch and Poway, and coastal work reaches Del Mar, Solana Beach, Encinitas and La Jolla. The towns below are ones Craft names on its own site or in its project portfolio, so you can see work close to home.

faq.h2: What San Diego homeowners ask Craft

items.q: Do I need to hire a separate interior designer?
items.a: Usually not. Joey Dahan helps clients reach a finished design without a separate design contract, and he says he tries to do that on every bathroom project. You will still choose every tile, fixture and finish, with Joey guiding the options and explaining what works in your space and budget.

Yes. Craft holds California contractor license #1114525 and states on every page that it is licensed, bonded and insured. The site also shows an NKBA affiliation and the Best of Houzz Service 2026 award, and the company holds a 5.0 rating across 35 Google reviews.

Yes. Craft offers free estimates, and its process starts with a free consultation where you share your goals and see layout and color ideas. A construction proposal with a clear scope of work follows. Call (858) 888-9139 or email connect@crafthomeremodel.com to set up your consult.

items.q: Which parts of San Diego do you serve?
items.a: Craft is based in Rancho Bernardo and lists service across the county, including Carmel Valley, 4S Ranch, Scripps Ranch, Poway, Del Mar, Solana Beach, Encinitas, Rancho Santa Fe, Carlsbad, Coronado and La Mesa. Recent portfolio projects come from La Jolla, Sorrento Valley, North Park and Encinitas.

items.q: Do you remodel kitchens and whole homes too?
items.a: Yes. Kitchen remodels are the most common job in Craft's Google reviews, and the portfolio includes complete home remodels in Rancho Santa Fe, Solana Beach and Del Mar plus additions and ADUs. Many clients combine a bathroom with a kitchen or living room so one team handles the whole plan.

final_cta.text: Call Joey's team at (858) 888-9139 or email connect@crafthomeremodel.com to talk through your space.
